Write a starter handler beside each query or procedure lexicon under src/ that has none.

The handler is in the language of the first [interpreters] entry and names its collection:
--collection's, else one chosen at a prompt, else the placeholder COLLECTION under a TODO comment.
An existing handler, in any language, is never replaced.

Usage: hpy happyview scaffold [OPTIONS] [NSID]...

Arguments:
  [NSID]...
          Only these query or procedure lexicons (default: every one without a handler)

Options:
      --collection <NSID>
          The collection every handler written reads or writes (default: asked for each, else the
          placeholder COLLECTION)

      --json
          Print the result as JSON on stdout

      --no-input
          Never prompt; fail when a value is missing. Irreversible actions still need --yes. Implied
          without a terminal

  -C <DIR>
          Run as if started in DIR

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
